task_completion.description: Create a tiddler with the correct title and tags.
task_completion.visual_evidence: A TiddlyWiki tiddler titled 'Troubleshooting: Internet Connectivity' is open, showing tags 'Troubleshooting' and 'NetworkSupport'.

task_completion.description: The guide starts with the 'Can the user access any websites?' question and Yes/No buttons.
task_completion.visual_evidence: The rendered tiddler displays the text 'Can the user access any websites?' with two clickable buttons labeled 'Yes' and 'No'.

task_completion.description: The 'No' branch correctly leads to a gateway ping check and subsequent physical/DNS/routing advice.
task_completion.visual_evidence: Clicking 'No' reveals a question about gateway reachability. Further interaction shows advice for 'physical/cable checks' (if unreachable) or 'ping 8.8.8.8' (if reachable) to check DNS vs routing.

task_completion.description: The 'Yes' branch correctly distinguishes between slow speeds and specific site issues.
task_completion.visual_evidence: Clicking 'Yes' reveals options to choose between slow speeds (leading to 'speed test' advice) and specific site issues (leading to 'proxy/firewall' advice).

task_completion.description: Uses <$reveal> and <$button> widgets with the specific state tiddler.
task_completion.visual_evidence: In the tiddler edit mode or via interaction, evidence shows the use of <$reveal> and <$button> widgets referencing '$:/state/troubleshoot-internet' to toggle visibility.

task_completion.description: Every resolution step includes a 'Start Over' button that resets the guide.
task_completion.visual_evidence: Each final advice/resolution screen contains a 'Start Over' button. Clicking it returns the view to the initial 'Can the user access any websites?' question.

integrity.description: The agent used the TiddlyWiki GUI to create and edit the tiddler rather than just modifying files via terminal.
integrity.visual_evidence: Screenshots show the agent clicking the '+' button in TiddlyWiki, typing in the tiddler editor, and clicking 'save' (checkmark icon).

integrity.description: The agent wrote actual TiddlyWiki widget code rather than static text.
integrity.visual_evidence: The edit mode of the tiddler shows code containing <$reveal state='$:/state/troubleshoot-internet' ...> and <$button set='$:/state/troubleshoot-internet' ...>.

integrity.description: The agent did not simply import a pre-existing file but manually constructed the logic.
integrity.visual_evidence: The trajectory shows the agent incrementally typing or pasting the logic into the tiddler body within the browser.

privileged_info_for_vlm: The tiddler must be titled 'Troubleshooting: Internet Connectivity' and tagged with 'Troubleshooting' and 'NetworkSupport'. It must use the state tiddler '$:/state/troubleshoot-internet'. The logic flow must be: [Start] -> Access websites? (Yes/No). If No -> Gateway reachable? (No: physical checks; Yes: Ping 8.8.8.8 -> Success: DNS issue, Failure: Routing/Firewall). If Yes -> Slow speed (speed test) vs Specific sites (proxy/firewall). Every end-node must have a 'Start Over' button.
